name: scene-picking
description: Selects an employee by clicking them in the 3D scene (not a panel row) and opens their crew detail via the selection bar's DETAIL action — proves P2's read-only scene picking is reachable by a real player, not just a console command.

expect.note: baseline before hiring, so the next beat's 'increased' assertion actually measures something

beats.goal: hire a driller from the Crew panel
click the hired driller in the 3D scene

expect.note: a dashed selection ring should appear on the ground and the bottom selection bar should show Detail/Dispatch Here/Train for the clicked employee

beats.goal: open the crew detail from the selection bar's DETAIL action

expect.note: DETAIL must open the Crew panel with this exact employee's row expanded, not just bring the panel to the front
the close (x) button is the only one of the bar's buttons without a data-action
